lesson_variants.story_theme_th: Ton is learning Geometry with objects from class. The teacher gives two important numbers: 6 and 5. Ton reads the problem slowly and decides which operation matches the story. Then he draws a simple model so he can see the numbers clearly. The model helps him write a number sentence and check that the answer uses the correct unit. He does not guess from the numbers alone. He asks, what does each number mean, and what is the question asking? After that, he connects the picture to the number sentence. This habit helps him solve a new problem with different numbers later.

story_variants.title: Geometry Variant 1
story_variants.story: Ton is learning Geometry with objects from class. The teacher gives two important numbers: 6 and 5. Ton reads the problem slowly and decides which operation matches the story. Then he draws a simple model so he can see the numbers clearly. The model helps him write a number sentence and check that the answer uses the correct unit. He does not guess from the numbers alone. He asks, what does each number mean, and what is the question asking? After that, he connects the picture to the number sentence. This habit helps him solve a new problem with different numbers later.
story_variants.think_story: The key numbers are 6 and 5. Choose the operation that matches Geometry. Use the model to get 30.
